text.aria-label: Title text 'On cold British Summer Time nights the jump arrives one hour later on the clock, so the step follows UTC at 12 of 14 substations'
text.tspan: On cold British Summer Time nights the jump arrives one hour later on
the clock, so the step follows UTC at 12 of 14 substations

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Chosen after seeing the data, and its error rate has not been tested. Each dot is the local- clock half-hour of the largest mean rise on nights with a daily mean below 8 C in British Summer Time, minus the same on winter nights, in half-hours (positive is later). Nights counted: 18 at D9, 68 to 90 at the others.'
text.tspan: Chosen after seeing the data, and its error rate has not been tested. Each dot is the local-
clock half-hour of the largest mean rise on nights with a daily mean below 8 C in British
Summer Time, minus the same on winter nights, in half-hours (positive is later). Nights
counted: 18 at D9, 68 to 90 at the others.
